commits.subject: ui: pdf - EMF clipping, stock fonts, device pixels and world transforms
commits.body:
The EMF renderer (TPdfEnum) fixes of mORMot2-PDF-CrossPlatform PR #100:
- EMR_INTERSECTCLIPRECT is a clip region of its own: it clipped nothing
  without a region, and text after SelectClipRgn was clipped to an empty
  box; its rectangle and the ETO_CLIPPED one are exclusive (BoxExclI)
- the rectangles of EMR_EXTSELECTCLIPRGN are device units, mapped as
  logical ones before (ten times too small at 10 units per pixel)
- the bounds of EMR_HEADER and of an ExtTextOut are device pixels with the
  last one included: a bitmap at the edge lost two pixel columns and rows
- a stock font is measured from its own LOGFONT: it kept the size and
  metrics of the font before, and text before any selection had size 0
  (EMR_HEADER selects SYSTEM_FONT); a raster face stays in device pixels
  under any map mode, a TrueType or vector face (DEFAULT_GUI_FONT) in
  logical units; TFontSpec holds single values, which rounded to 0 at 32
  pixels per unit
- a shape under a world scale covers one device pixel more, not one
  logical unit of the map mode (AddDevicePixel)
- a world rotation or shear no longer keeps the scale and move of the
  transform before it; text under a rotation is turned the way GDI turns
  it; a mirroring world scale is applied, the world before the window and
  viewport, line widths positive, glyphs upright, both factors negative
  turning the text by 180 degrees

Six regression tests in test.ui.pdf (TTestUiPdf.EmfStockFontMetrics,
EmfClipBoxes, EmfWorldBoxes, EmfBitmapBounds, EmfWorldRotation,
EmfWorldReflection): 111 of their assertions fail before this change.
Delphi 7, Delphi 13 Win32/Win64, FPC 3.3.1 aarch64 and FPC 3.2.2 Win64
pass all; FPC 3.2.2 Win32 fails MetafileRenderingAndOrientation #3 with
or without this change.

commits.subject: db: load unixODBC on macOS
commits.body:
- libodbc.so.1 does not exist on macOS: unixODBC installs libodbc.2.dylib
- Homebrew (/opt/homebrew/lib on Apple Silicon, /usr/local/lib on Intel) and
  MacPorts (/opt/local/lib) are not in the default dyld search path, so
  those locations are tried after the bare name
- checked on aarch64-darwin with Homebrew unixODBC: TOdbcLib.Create failed
  before and loads now, with FPC 3.3.1 and 3.2.2
commits.author: stefan-nolte

commits.subject: core: fixed GetPublishedMethods on FPC 3.3+ aarch64
commits.body:
- FPC 3.2 and older emit a packed VMT method table even on targets with
  FPC_REQUIRES_PROPER_ALIGNMENT, so the entries were read at the hardcoded
  offset 4
- since FPC 3.3 the emitted table follows the TVmtMethodTable declaration,
  which puts the entries at offset 8 on aarch64: reading them at offset 4
  gave a shifted pointer and an access violation, e.g. when a TSynTestCase
  enumerates its published methods
- the offset now comes from TVmtMethodTable on FPC 3.3+, and stays 4 for
  FPC 3.2 and older
- checked on aarch64-darwin: FPC 3.3.1 raised EAccessViolation before and
  lists all methods now, FPC 3.2.2 is unchanged
commits.author: stefan-nolte
